// census-want: 0
// W02-09 Z4: the production shape of the sub-block walk — the attempt
// literal calls the attempt method, which hands each block (under its
// lease) to the block function holding the one EmbedRaw call; the closure
// goes to the walk's parameter of type blockFunc, which calls it under the
// block's lease (hardening H-8: the census asks the callee's parameter type).
package oai

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/backends"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/embed"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"
)

func (c *call) wireBlock(b *backends.Backend, lo, hi int, lease *dispatch.Lease, rc context.Context) (dispatch.Usage, error) {
	_, _, err := embed.EmbedRaw(rc, *b, "m", c.inputs[lo:hi], 0)
	return dispatch.Usage{}, err
}

func (r *subBlockRun) run(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration, do blockFunc) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
	u, err := do(0, 1, lease, runCtx)
	return u, true, err
}

func (c *call) attempt(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
	return c.run.run(runCtx, b, lease, t, func(lo, hi int, bl *dispatch.Lease, rc context.Context) (dispatch.Usage, error) {
		return c.wireBlock(b, lo, hi, bl, rc)
	})
}

func (c *call) walk(ctx context.Context, chain []backends.Backend) {
	_, _, _ = llm.WalkChain(ctx, chain, "embed", c.acq, nil, llm.WalkRules{},
		func(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
			return c.attempt(runCtx, b, lease, t)
		})
}
